# SYNESIS_E124 — Warning

## Description

Target `TARGET` not accepted in MAP RELATIONS.

## Severity

This diagnostic is **local to an `EXPORT` block**. When compiling it is reported as a warning and the corpus still compiles; in `synesis export` it stops that block (that artifact is not written) and the other blocks run.

## Compiler message

```text
`EXPORT <FORMAT> <name>`: `TARGET` is not a MAP RELATIONS target. Accepted targets:
  HIERARCHY KIND, HIERARCHY PART, HIERARCHY INSTANCE and RELATED.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **MapTargetNotAllowed**: `block`, `target`
